# The refusal sites in cmd/ that print no remedy the source shows, one
# file:function:kind per row with why it is left (internal/ci/remedy_class_test.go,
# the remedy rule). A row leaves when its line names its next step (`; run:
# <command>`, remedy=, oneline.WithRemedy) or goes away; it never comes back.
# This list only shrinks: the class test fails on a row whose site has left as
# well as on a site that is not listed, and NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 drops a stale row
# and never adds one.
# A row is `file:function:kind <sites> <reason>`: <sites> is how many sites the row covers, and it
# only falls. A new site under a listed key (a discard with no `// ignored:`, a `|| true`,
# a `2>/dev/null`, a refusal with no remedy, an OK beside a failing exit) makes the
# count too low and the run red, and fixing a site makes the count too high and the
# run red until it is lowered (NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 lowers it, and never raises one).
# ceiling: 7
cmd/nova-fuse/main.go:cmdLift:refuse-print 1 the remedy for a blown fuse is a live conversation with the person, by design (see the comment above the print); no command lifts a lockdown
cmd/nova-fuse/main.go:cmdLockdown:refuse-print 1 the line says stop by hand and tell the person, by design: a lockdown that cannot be written is not a thing a command fixes
cmd/nova-redis/main.go:failed:exit-2 1 the line is built into a variable first: err= carries redisconn's own next step, and remedy= is added for an unset password variable
cmd/nova-sandbox/runwin.go:finishWindows:refuse-print 1 the SANDBOX LEAK line printed just before it carries remedy="rmdir /s /q <dir>"; this NOTE says why
cmd/nova-sprint/run.go:app.cmdTick:exit-2 2 under --json the error is the object's error field; otherwise printTick has printed it on stderr the line before
cmd/nova-sprint/run.go:app.setMachine:exit-2 1 under --json the error is the object's error field on stdout, which a reader of the JSON reads there
cmd/nova-swarm/workercheck.go:cmdWorker:exit-2 1 each drift line on stdout names the field that drifted and what the description wants
